self|dnd_oneshot_request: User requested a D&D one-shot adventure for level 8 player characters, with detailed descriptions of all aspects to help a GM run it smoothly
self|dnd_oneshot_requested_elements: The one-shot should include enemy stat blocks, loot for a successful party, a surprise twist in the final battle, cool lair actions, and traps described in detail
assistant|oneshot_title: The assistant titled the one-shot adventure "The Lost Temple of the Djinn"
assistant|oneshot_zoltar_lore: In the one-shot's backstory, a powerful Djinn named Zoltar once ruled a vast treasure-filled temple as a just ruler, then disappeared and the temple was lost to the sands of time
assistant|oneshot_premise: The one-shot's hook: a wealthy collector has hired the party to retrieve an artifact from the lost temple, having located the temple but lacking the power to retrieve the artifact himself
assistant|oneshot_enemies: The temple is filled with mummies, undead warriors, and constructs guarding its treasures
assistant|enemy_mummy_stats: Mummy stat block (x4): AC 11, HP 45 (6d8+18), Speed 20 ft., immune to poison and psychic damage, immune to charmed/exhaustion/frightened/paralyzed/petrified/poisoned; Curse of the Pharaohs (DC 15 Wis save or cursed, cannot regain HP and max HP reduced by 10 (3d6) for 24 hours) and Mummy Rot (DC 15 Con save after Slam hit)
assistant|enemy_construct_guardian_stats: Construct Guardian stat block (x2): AC 17 (natural armor), HP 110 (13d10+30), Speed 30 ft., immune to poison and psychic damage, same condition immunities; traits Immutable Form, Magic Resistance, Magic Weapons, and Siege Monster (double damage to objects/structures)
assistant|enemy_skeletal_warrior_stats: Skeletal Warrior stat block (x6): AC 12, HP 22 (5d8), Speed 30 ft., immune to poison and psychic damage, same condition immunities; Undead Fortitude (on dropping to 0 HP, Con save DC 5 + damage taken, success means 1 HP instead, unless radiant or critical hit)
assistant|trap_pressure_plate_puzzle: Pressure Plate Puzzle trap: a room filled with floor pressure plates where stepping on the wrong plate triggers a poison dart trap; a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals which plates are safe
assistant|trap_spinning_blade_trap: Spinning Blade Trap: a hallway filled with spinning blades that activate when the party steps on a pressure plate, avoided with a DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check
